body:
From MMR-34 (accepted): the startup initializer refuses a world with `GeneratedCampaignInitializer.StartupException`. It carries quality codes from `worldgen/policies/startup.json` (`quality.codes`), and `Retryable` is true only when every code is:
- retryable: `quality.startup_no_start`, `quality.startup_hideouts`, `quality.startup_retreat`, `quality.startup_unplaceable_spawn`, `quality.startup_map`;
- not retryable: `quality.startup_catalog`, `quality.startup_plan`, `quality.startup_policy`.

They are kept in startup.json, not world-quality.json, whose hash is part of the generation identity and the MMR-24 evidence. The generation job should record them with the job result and retry on the retryable ones. Tested offline: spawn-policy check 18.
